def get_sequence_correct(n, k):
    seq = list(range(1, n + 1))
    for _ in range(k):
        new_seq = []
        for i in range(len(seq) - 1):
            new_seq.append(seq[i])
            new_seq.append(seq[i] + seq[i+1])
        new_seq.append(seq[-1])
        seq = new_seq
    return seq
